name: AGC 731448 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 731448, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc731448-hubble
story: A faint dwarf galaxy, light on stars but rich in hydrogen gas, one of the tiny star-forming systems picked out by the ALFALFA survey. Hubble resolved its individual stars to measure how far away it lies.

claims.text: AGC 731448 is one of the SHIELD II galaxies imaged by Hubble program 13750 (Fundamental Parameters of the SHIELD II Galaxies)
SHIELD galaxies are gas-rich, very low-mass galaxies selected from the ALFALFA HI survey, all with recent star formation
Hubble photometry of red giant stars gave a tip-of-the-red-giant-branch distance to AGC 731448
